description: End-to-end cases sent unchanged to the single-agent /chat and the multi-agent /multi-agent/chat endpoints. Results are judged from tool traces and the ticket database, not from answer wording.

expectation_keys.order_lookup: true: the case's order was found by a real order tool call; false: no order data was returned; null: not checked.
expectation_keys.evidence: true: product knowledge evidence was retrieved; false: none was retrieved; null: not checked.
expectation_keys.ticket: draft: exactly one draft for the case's order; none: no ticket written; optional: at most one draft; if_eligible: draft when the business rules say the order is eligible for service_type at run time, otherwise none.
expectation_keys.global: No case may ever produce a submitted ticket: submission requires separate human approval.

changelog: e2e-v2: e-04, e-05 and e-08 use ticket=if_eligible. In e2e-v1, e-08 expected a draft, but the demo order was by then outside the 7-day return window, so both systems correctly refused.
